input:
Also, can we get a summary of recent tasks and letters tied to our account?
The customer wants a summary of recent tasks and letters linked to their account, which is not currently available.

our finance team needs clearer reporting on reserves versus actual payments — it’s causing delays in supplier reconciliation.
Finance team cannot see clear reports comparing reserves to actual payments, leading to reconciliation delays.

Keelwater isn’t accessible — I think it... when they try... log in through ... corporate portal.
Users cannot access Keelwater when logging in via the corporate portal.

We’re getting the same claim ... when a ...  ...  ...  ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... …
Duplicate claims are created when a policyholder reports the same incident through multiple channels.

I’m trying to get a batch of policyholder documents into a single claim — is there a way to do that without uploading each one separately?
The user cannot add multiple policyholder documents to a claim in one step and must upload each file individually.

can we at least manually merge them without losing any documents or supplier notes?
The user cannot manually merge duplicate records without risking loss of documents or supplier notes.

Also, repair updates missing — we’re on the phone daily with garages because there’s no live ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...
Repair updates are not provided in real time.

Exactly — it’s not just delays, it’s affecting policyholder trust too.
Delays in the claims process are eroding policyholder trust.

Well, the issue is that last week the claims dashboard suddenly shifted where the reserves tab sits — no heads-up, no training notes, nothing.
The claims dashboard moved the reserves tab without any notification or guidance.

Claim details: click "Save", rage x3
Saving claim details fails and makes the user angry.

it’s creating a backlog on the approval waiting list... when a reserve change exceeds authority, it sits in one approver’s queue with no delegate, and that creates a backlog on the approval waiting list
Reserve changes that exceed authority get stuck in a single approver's queue with no delegate, causing claim approval backlogs and payment delays.

We’re seeing a duplicate loss report scenario where the same incident comes in via phone and portal, creating two claims without any intake warning — we’ve even spotted disabled UI buttons that should allow linking but don’t work.
Duplicate loss reports create multiple claims without warning and the UI linking buttons are disabled.

Finance is questioning which figure is correct because the export doesn’t match the dashboard — the export figures mismatch is causing delays in our month-end close.
Exported data does not match the dashboard figures, causing confusion and delays.

Our reporting team’s been waiting on those reserves to update, and it’s holding up the month-end close.
Reserves data is not updating promptly, delaying the reporting team's month‑end close.

Exactly — we ... we’re drowning ... and our reporting ... is all over the place.
The customer is overwhelmed by too many supplier invoices and policyholder letters, and their reporting is disorganized.

The interface changes last month moved key controls without warning — we had to retrain staff because of those unexpected interface changes.
Unexpected interface changes moved key controls, forcing staff to be retrained.

The payments show as pending but reserves aren’t updating.
Reserves are not updating for pending payments on commercial property claims.

We’ve got three claims stuck waiting on garage replies again today.
Claims are stuck waiting for garage replies, causing delays.

just the approval waiting list is the big blocker
The approval waiting list is causing a blockage.

I’m trying to get a batch of claim docs into the system for Kilnsey Household but it’s taking ages one by one. Any way to speed this up?
Uploading a batch of claim documents is slow because they must be entered one by one.

Documents: click "Document type", rage x5
The document type selector is difficult to use, requiring multiple clicks.

Exactly — and it’s not just annoying, it’s eating into time we could spend on policyholders or tasks.
The platform is missing repair updates, causing wasted time.

We’re also struggling with task assignments and letter generation—sometimes policyholders don’t get timely updates.
Customers are having difficulty with task assignments and generating letters, leading to delayed updates for policyholders.

We’re still having to call garages ourselves every day because the repair updates missing from the system — it’s becoming a real time-sink for our handlers.
Repair updates are not showing up in the system, forcing staff to call garages manually.

we need to schedule regular reviews for reserves and supplier payments—any way to automate that in Keelwater?
The customer cannot automate scheduling regular reviews for reserves and supplier payments in Keelwater.

That would really help — we’re also onboarding Wexmoor Motor at the same time, so consistency matters a lot.
They need a consistent onboarding experience across multiple customers.

We’re having trouble pulling the latest reserves report for our policyholders — it’s showing outdated figures even after we refreshed the tasks list.
The reserves report displays outdated figures even after refreshing the tasks list.

Your interface changes lately — controls moving without warning — it’s forcing us to retrain staff constantly, and unannounced screen changes are disrupting our operations.
Unexpected UI changes force constant staff retraining and disrupt operations.

can we get policyholder comms automated too? It’s another manual task.
Policyholder communications are manual because the platform lacks automation for them.

I’m trying to figure out why my latest batch of claims documents didn’t auto-assign to the right supplier tasks.
Claims documents are not auto‑assigning to the correct supplier tasks.

We’ve got claims stuck because the reserve change needs approval, and with the approver away and no delegate, the approval waiting list just grows — it’s not sustainable.
Claims are stuck because reserve changes require approval and there is no delegate when the approver is away.

That’s exactly what I’m after — especially how roles affect who can adjust those reserves before payment triggers.
User wants to know how role permissions affect the ability to adjust reserves before payment triggers.

Right now it’s a mix of spreadsheets and email threads — not ideal when we need to assign tasks or generate letters for policyholders.
The team is forced to use spreadsheets and email threads, which makes assigning tasks and generating policyholder letters inefficient.

I need to reset my password for the claims portal — can you help me with that right away?
User cannot log in because they need to reset their password.

The issue is that reserve updates beyond handler limits are stuck waiting for sign‑off with no backup approver, causing a reserve authorisation delay that halts payments and reporting.
Reserve updates that exceed handler limits get stuck waiting for sign‑off because there is no backup approver.

Great. We’re swamped with letters and payments too — anything to reduce that load helps.
The user is overwhelmed by the volume of letters and payments and wants a way to lessen that burden.

And the unexpected interface changes — last week the Claims Tasks panel vanished without warning, and we had to retrain our team mid-week.
Unexpected interface changes removed the Claims Tasks panel without warning, forcing the team to retrain mid‑week.

One last thing — can we trial the roles and tasks features before committing?
Customer wants a way to trial the roles and tasks features before committing.

everything looks correct, but the numbers still don’t match what we submitted last week.
The reported numbers do not match the data the customer submitted last week despite correct role assignments.

I was wondering if there’s a way to use keyboard shortcuts in claim notes to speed up data entry — it’d save us a lot of time during busy periods.
The claim notes interface lacks keyboard shortcuts for faster data entry.

One more thing — are we still on track for claim progress messages via SMS and email by Q1 2027? ... Our policyholders are expecting updates at key milestones.
The customer is uncertain about the delivery timeline for claim progress messages via SMS and email.

we’re trying to submit a high-value specie claim but hit a snag with document uploads.
The user cannot upload documents when submitting a high‑value specie claim.

I’m under the impression I’m assigned the right role, but maybe something’s misconfigured on our end.
The user’s role appears to be misconfigured, preventing proper access.

Administration: click "Overview", dead x1
The Overview page in the Administration section does not load when clicked.
